moa.t: Clears fetal RhD-positive red cells from the maternal circulation before sensitisation occurs

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Anti-D immunoglobulin, IM, 100 mcg as a single dose.
Anti-D immunoglobulin, IM, 300 mcg for every 30 mL haemorrhage. · Maximum dose: 1 200 mcg.
Anti-D immunoglobulin, IM, 50 mcg, preferably within 72 hours but may be given up to 7 days following management of miscarriage.
Anti-D immunoglobulin, IM, 100 mcg, preferably within 72 hours but can be given up to 7 days after delivery. Care of the newborn baby
Rh factor (if unknown) and give Rh prophylaxis if Rh negative (Anti-D immunoglobulin, IM, 100 mcg as a single dose) · Sexually transmitted infections (including HIV and syphilis).
Anti-D immunoglobulin, IM, 100 mcg as soon as possible after birth but within 72 hours of birth.

cautions.t: Give within 72 hours of the sensitising event
